about_the_game:
In space, a meteorite was floating. This meteorite contained an ancient fungus and poison from outside the Earth. It was unknown how much time had passed. Soon, this meteorite overcame all kinds of obstacles.

It came to the solar system and then to the Earth. Under the violent impact, the bacteria and toxins in the meteorite scattered on the Earth and seeped into the ground, interacting with the mycelium in the original soil of the Earth

After undergoing a combination and mutation, an intelligent bacterial community emerged and quickly took over the land. They used soil, rocks, various minerals, etc. to coalesce and form a kind

Unique bricks. And they occupied human cities. People were forced to leave their original residences and move underground. Eventually, they discovered their secrets and a great war was about to break out...

This game is relatively small in scale and is divided into six levels. In each level, you have to defend a boss. Only by eliminating the Boss can you pass the current level. Eliminate bricks to gain experience points for upgrading and obtaining equipment

You can also use gold coins to purchase items for emergencies. The game is of medium difficulty and requires patience. It can be used for leisure and entertainment! You can also give it a try. Have a great time playing!
